Method Detail

showValueDialog

public java.lang.String showValueDialog(javax.swing.JFrame frame,
                                        java.lang.String title,
                                        model.DEditDataType dt,
                                        java.lang.String initialValue)
Makes a JDialog with given parent JFrame, title, and initial value.

Parameters:
frame - the parent JFrame for this DEditLeafDialog
title - the String to go in the title of this dialog
dt - the DEditDataType for the node this dialog will edit
initialValue - the initial value (as a string) of the value in the leaf being edited
Returns:
the new value if "Accept" is chosen, null otherwise

showAttributeDialog

public model.DEditAttributeInfo[] showAttributeDialog(javax.swing.JFrame frame,
                                                      java.lang.String title,
                                                      model.DEditAttributeInfo[] atts)
Makes a JDialog with given parent JFrame, title, and information about the attributes.

Parameters:
frame - the parent JFrame for this DEditLeafDialog
title - the String to go in the title of this dialog
atts - a DEditAttributeInfo array used to store the information about attributes
Returns:
the attribute array result (actually the same as atts) if "Accept" is chosen, null otherwise

showAttValDialog

public java.lang.String showAttValDialog(javax.swing.JFrame frame,
                                         java.lang.String title,
                                         model.DEditDataType dt,
                                         java.lang.String initialValue,
                                         model.DEditAttributeInfo[] atts)
Makes a JDialog with given parent JFrame, title, initial value, and information about the attributes.

Parameters:
frame - the parent JFrame for this DEditLeafDialog
title - the String to go in the title of this dialog
dt - the DEditDataType for the node this dialog will edit
initialValue - the initial value (as a string) of the value in the leaf being edited
atts - a DEditAttributeInfo array used to store the information about attributes
Returns:
the new value for the edited node if "Accept" is chosen, null otherwise. atts has also changed to new values which should of course also not be set.
